nativeZh: vi. 去, 走, 达到, 运转, 查阅, 消失, 结束, 放弃, 花费, 流传, 趋于, 打算, 剩下
vt. 以...打赌, 对付, 忍受, 出产, 为被捕者出(保释金)
n. 去, 尝试, 进行

senses.en: a time for working (after which you will be relieved by someone else)
senses.zh: 一段轮班工作的时间，结束后由别人接替。

examples.en: it's my go
a spell of work

senses.en: street names for methylenedioxymethamphetamine
senses.zh: 摇头丸成分MDMA的街头俗称之一。

senses.en: a usually brief attempt
senses.zh: 通常为短暂尝试

examples.en: he took a crack at it
I gave it a whirl

senses.en: a board game for two players who place counters on a grid; the object is to surround and so capture the opponent's counters
senses.zh: 两人在棋盘交点落子，以包围并吃掉对方棋子为目标的棋类游戏，即围棋。

senses.en: change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
senses.zh: 改变位置；移动、旅行或前进，也用于比喻。

examples.en: How fast does your new car go?
We travelled from Rome to Naples by bus
examples.zh: 我们从罗马乘公交车到那不勒斯

examples.en: The policemen went from door to door looking for the suspect
examples.zh: 警察们从门到门都找了嫌犯

examples.en: The soldiers moved towards the city in an attempt to take it before night fell
examples.zh: 士兵们向城内移动 试图在夜幕降临前夺取城池

examples.en: news travelled fast

senses.en: follow a procedure or take a course
senses.zh: 按某种程序或方式行事。
senses.labelZh: 继续下去；继续进行；进行

examples.en: We should go farther in this matter
examples.zh: 我们应该把这件事进一步推进。

examples.en: She went through a lot of trouble
go about the world in a certain manner
Messages must go through diplomatic channels
examples.zh: 信息必须经过外交渠道

senses.en: move away from a place into another direction
senses.zh: 离开某处，向另一个方向移动。

examples.en: Go away before I start to cry
The train departs at noon

senses.en: enter or assume a certain state or condition
senses.zh: 进入或呈现某种状态。

examples.en: He became annoyed when he heard the bad news
examples.zh: 听到坏消息后,他变得很生气

examples.en: It must be getting more serious
her face went red with anger
She went into ecstasy
Get going!

senses.en: be awarded; be allotted
senses.zh: 被授予；被分配给。

examples.en: The first prize goes to Mary
Her money went on clothes

senses.en: have a particular form
senses.zh: 具有特定形式

examples.en: the story or argument runs as follows
as the saying goes...

senses.en: stretch out over a distance, space, time, or scope; run or extend between two points or beyond a certain point
senses.zh: 伸展到距离、空间、时间或范围;在两点之间或某一点以外运行或延伸

examples.en: Service runs all the way to Cranbury
examples.zh: 这项交通服务一直通到克兰伯里。

examples.en: His knowledge doesn't go very far
My memory extends back to my fourth year of life
examples.zh: 我的记忆可以追溯到四岁时。

examples.en: The facts extend beyond a consideration of her personal assets
examples.zh: 事实超出了对她个人资产的考虑范围

senses.en: follow a certain course
senses.zh: 遵循一定的路线

examples.en: The inauguration went well
how did your interview go?

senses.en: be abolished or discarded
senses.zh: 被取消或丢弃

examples.en: These ugly billboards have to go!
examples.zh: 这些难看的广告牌必须拆掉！

examples.en: These luxuries all had to go under the Khmer Rouge
examples.zh: 在红色高棉统治下，这些奢侈享受都不得不取消。

senses.en: be or continue to be in a certain condition
senses.zh: 处于或继续处于某种状态

examples.en: The children went hungry that day

senses.en: make a certain noise or sound
senses.zh: 发出某种声音。
senses.labelZh: 发出响声；发出噪音；发出声音

examples.en: She went `Mmmmm'
The gun went `bang'

senses.en: perform as expected when applied
senses.zh: 使用时能够按预期发挥作用。

examples.en: The washing machine won't go unless it's plugged in
examples.zh: 洗衣机不插上电源就不会运转。

examples.en: Does this old car still run well?
examples.zh: 这辆旧车还运行顺利吗?

examples.en: This old radio doesn't work anymore
examples.zh: 这台旧收音机已经不行了

senses.en: to be spent or finished
senses.zh: 被耗尽或用完。

examples.en: The money had gone after a few days
Gas is running low at the gas stations in the Midwest
examples.zh: 美国中西部加油站的汽油快用完了。

senses.en: progress by being changed
senses.zh: 通过变化而发展。

examples.en: The speech has to go through several more drafts
examples.zh: 这篇演讲稿还得再改几稿。

examples.en: run through your presentation before the meeting
examples.zh: 开会前把你的演示内容演练一遍。

senses.en: continue to live through hardship or adversity
senses.zh: 在困难或逆境中继续生存。

examples.en: We went without water and food for 3 days
examples.zh: 我们有3天没水喝、没东西吃。

examples.en: These superstitions survive in the backwaters of America
examples.zh: 这些迷信仍存在于美国一些偏僻落后的地区。

examples.en: The race car driver lived through several very serious accidents
examples.zh: 那位赛车手在数次非常严重的事故中幸存了下来。

examples.en: how long can a person last without food and water?
examples.zh: 没有食物和水一个人能持续多久?

senses.en: pass, fare, or elapse; of a certain state of affairs or action
senses.zh: （事情或行动）进展、进行或经过。

examples.en: How is it going?
The day went well until I got your call
examples.zh: 在接到你的电话之前，这一天都过得很顺利。

senses.en: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
senses.zh: 死亡；失去维持生命所需的身体属性和功能。

examples.en: She died from cancer
The children perished in the fire
The patient went peacefully
The old guy kicked the bucket at the age of 102
examples.zh: 那老人在102岁时去世了。（原文为非正式表达。）

senses.en: be in the right place or situation
senses.zh: 处于合适的位置或场合。

examples.en: Where do these books belong?
Let's put health care where it belongs--under the control of the government
examples.zh: 让我们把医疗保健放到它应在的位置——由政府管理。

examples.en: Where do these books go?

senses.en: be ranked or compare
senses.zh: 在比较中处于某种位置或等级。

examples.en: This violinist is as good as Juilliard-trained violinists go
examples.zh: 就茱莉亚音乐学院培养的小提琴手而言，这位演奏者算是出色的。

senses.en: begin or set in motion
senses.zh: 开始或启动

examples.en: I start at eight in the morning
Ready, set, go!

senses.en: have a turn; make one's move in a game
senses.zh: 轮到行动；在游戏中走一步或出一招。

examples.en: Can I go now?

senses.en: be contained in
senses.zh: 被包含在内；能够容纳。

examples.en: How many times does 18 go into 54?

senses.en: be sounded, played, or expressed
senses.zh: 被奏出、唱出或表达出来。

examples.en: How does this song go again?

senses.en: blend or harmonize
senses.zh: 相互融合或协调。

examples.en: This flavor will blend with those in your dish
examples.zh: 这种味道会与你菜里的其他味道相融合。

examples.en: This sofa won't go with the chairs
examples.zh: 这张沙发和那些椅子不搭配。

senses.en: lead, extend, or afford access
senses.zh: 通向、延伸到或提供进入的通道。

examples.en: This door goes to the basement
The road runs South

senses.en: be the right size or shape; fit correctly or as desired
senses.zh: 大小或形状正确; 合适或符合要求

examples.en: This piece won't fit into the puzzle

senses.en: go through in search of something; search through someone's belongings in an unauthorized way
senses.zh: 翻找某物；未经允许翻动他人的物品。

examples.en: Who rifled through my desk drawers?
examples.zh: 谁翻乱了我的书桌抽屉？

senses.en: be spent
senses.zh: 被花费或耗用。

examples.en: All my money went for food and rent
examples.zh: 我的钱都花在了食物和房租上

senses.en: give support (to) or make a choice (of) one out of a group or number
senses.zh: 给予支持或从一个组或数中作出选择;

examples.en: I plumped for the losing candidates
examples.zh: 我坚定地支持了那些最后落选的候选人。

senses.en: stop operating or functioning
senses.zh: 停止运行或失去功能。

examples.en: The engine finally went
The car died on the road
The bus we travelled in broke down on the way to town
examples.zh: 我们乘坐的公交车在去城里的路上坏了

examples.en: The coffee maker broke
The engine failed on the way to town
examples.zh: 引擎在去城里的路上故障了

examples.en: her eyesight went after the accident

senses.en: functioning correctly and ready for action
senses.zh: 正确运作并准备采取行动

examples.en: all systems are go
examples.zh: 所有系统都已准备就绪。
